model_system: noncollinear antiferromagnetic Mn3GaN / SrTiO3 / Mn3GaN antiferromagnetic tunnel junction; illustrative kagome-lattice noncollinear AFM model

key_params.spin_polarization_definition: p_k|| = s_k|| / sum_n |s_nk||| with s_k|| = (l_z/2pi) sum_n ∫ <psi_nk|s|psi_nk> delta(E_nk-E_F) dk_z

headline_claim: Mn3GaN exhibits nearly 100% spin-polarized states and, when tunneling through low-decay-rate evanescent states of SrTiO3, yields ETMR as large as 10^4%.
replication_difficulty: high - requires first-principles spin-texture-resolved tunneling through an epitaxial AFMTJ plus k-resolved transmission matching.
